explication: FreeCAD is a cross-platform parametric 3D modeler. Its principal workflow is to create constrained 2D geometry, build and revise a 3D model through parameters and model history, then produce dimensioned production drawings. The README also identifies Python scripting, the OpenCASCADE geometry kernel, Coin3D scene representation, and Qt UI, and lists workbench breadth including architecture and engineering. Source excerpts show expression dependency evaluation, sketch drag auto-constraints, FEM post-processing, reverse-engineering operations, and scene-graph drag/drop. Several capability links rely on README-level descriptions; unsampled implementations are represented only at supported paths.
